topics.title: Security Foundations
topics.summary: Frame security through assets, adversaries, trust, risk, controls, assurance, and resilient recovery.
outcomes: Distinguish confidentiality, integrity, availability, authenticity, and accountability
Model assets, threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, impact, and residual risk
Layer preventive, detective, responsive, and recovery controls

topics.title: Threat Modeling
topics.summary: Convert architecture into assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, mitigations, and testable security requirements.
outcomes: Draw trust boundaries
Apply STRIDE without checklist theater
Prioritize mitigations by risk and evidence

topics.title: Applied Cryptography
topics.summary: Select standard cryptographic primitives and protocols for confidentiality, integrity, authenticity, passwords, randomness, and key lifecycle.
outcomes: Choose hashes, MACs, AEAD, signatures, KDFs, and CSPRNGs correctly
Explain nonce, randomness, key separation, and password hashing
Design key generation, storage, rotation, revocation, and crypto agility

topics.title: PKI and TLS
topics.summary: Operate certificate trust, issuance, validation, revocation, automation, and TLS policy across internal and public systems.
outcomes: Explain certificate chains, extensions, validation, and revocation
Design public and private CA hierarchy and issuance
Automate certificate lifecycle and respond to key compromise

topics.title: Identity and Access Management
topics.summary: Design human and workload identity, authentication, federation, authorization, lifecycle, privileged access, and audit.
outcomes: Separate identity proofing, authentication, federation, and authorization
Compare RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC, and policy enforcement
Design joiner-mover-leaver and privileged-access lifecycle

topics.title: Web Security
topics.summary: Secure browser applications against injection, XSS, CSRF, clickjacking, session theft, origin confusion, and unsafe content.
outcomes: Explain browser origin, cookie, CSP, CORS, and rendering trust
Prevent XSS, CSRF, injection, session, and navigation attacks
Design layered browser-facing defenses and verification

topics.title: API Security
topics.summary: Secure APIs against broken object/function authorization, unsafe input, abuse, SSRF, inventory drift, and dependency failure.
outcomes: Apply authentication and object/action-level authorization
Control schemas, resources, rate, outbound requests, and sensitive data
Inventory, test, observe, and retire API versions safely

topics.title: Network Security
topics.summary: Protect and investigate network paths through segmentation, identity, filtering, secure remote access, detection, and resilient architecture.
outcomes: Model zones, flows, trust boundaries, and choke points
Apply deny-default segmentation, secure access, egress control, and DDoS layers
Use network telemetry without treating the network as sufficient identity

topics.title: Secure Coding
topics.summary: Prevent vulnerability classes through explicit trust boundaries, safe language/library choices, invariants, review, and security-focused tests.
outcomes: Apply safe input, output, memory, error, concurrency, and secret practices
Recognize injection, traversal, deserialization, integer, and memory-safety risks
Use review, static/dynamic analysis, fuzzing, and sanitizers effectively

topics.title: Application Security
topics.summary: Embed threat modeling, requirements, review, testing, dependency governance, release gates, and vulnerability response into product delivery.
outcomes: Design a risk-based secure development lifecycle
Combine review, SAST, DAST, SCA, fuzzing, and penetration testing
Triage findings by reachability, exploitability, impact, and compensating controls

topics.title: Cloud Security
topics.summary: Secure cloud hierarchy, identity, network, data, control planes, posture, logging, and incident recovery under shared responsibility.
outcomes: Apply shared responsibility across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Design landing-zone guardrails and workload isolation
Detect and respond to identity, data, network, and control-plane compromise

topics.title: Container Security
topics.summary: Secure container source, build, image, registry, runtime, host, isolation, secrets, and incident evidence.
outcomes: Harden image build and provenance
Reduce runtime privilege and host attack surface
Triage image vulnerabilities by deployed reachability and containment

topics.title: Kubernetes Security
topics.summary: Secure Kubernetes API access, tenancy, workloads, admission, network, secrets, nodes, supply chain, audit, and response.
outcomes: Harden control plane, RBAC, service accounts, and admission
Apply Pod Security, network policy, secrets, and node isolation
Investigate and contain Kubernetes compromise

topics.title: Software Supply Chain
topics.summary: Protect source, dependencies, build identities, pipelines, artifacts, registries, provenance, and update channels from compromise.
outcomes: Threat-model source-to-production trust
Use SBOM, signatures, provenance, isolation, and policy correctly
Respond to compromised dependency, builder, artifact, or signing identity

topics.title: DevSecOps
topics.summary: Integrate risk, policy, secure defaults, automated evidence, exceptions, and feedback into fast delivery and operations.
outcomes: Place security checks at the earliest faithful stage
Design policy-as-code and exception workflows
Share security ownership without shifting all work to developers

topics.title: Vulnerability Management
topics.summary: Inventory, prioritize, remediate, mitigate, verify, and communicate vulnerabilities using exploit and business context.
outcomes: Build asset and component visibility
Prioritize beyond severity using exposure, reachability, exploitation, and impact
Run patch, mitigation, exception, verification, and disclosure workflows

topics.title: Detection Engineering
topics.summary: Turn threat hypotheses into reliable telemetry, analytics, enrichment, testing, triage, and measurable detection coverage.
outcomes: Write behavior-based detection hypotheses
Engineer telemetry, normalization, correlation, and enrichment
Test and measure detections through versioned lifecycle

topics.title: Incident Response
topics.summary: Handle security incidents through preparation, evidence-led triage, containment, eradication, recovery, communication, and lessons.
outcomes: Classify and coordinate security incidents
Preserve evidence while containing identities, hosts, network, and data paths
Recover trusted state and meet legal, regulatory, customer, and learning needs

topics.title: Forensics Basics
topics.summary: Collect, preserve, validate, analyze, and report digital evidence from endpoints, memory, networks, cloud, and applications.
outcomes: Preserve evidence integrity and chain of custody
Prioritize volatile and durable evidence sources
Build defensible timelines while distinguishing fact, interpretation, and uncertainty

topics.title: AI Security
topics.summary: Secure AI systems against data, model, prompt, tool, retrieval, supply-chain, privacy, abuse, and availability threats.
outcomes: Threat-model training, inference, RAG, and agent boundaries
Control prompt injection, tool authority, data leakage, poisoning, and model supply chain
Evaluate security with adversarial tests, monitoring, and incident response

topics.title: Fintech Security
topics.summary: Protect money movement, account access, financial data, ledgers, processors, fraud controls, audit, and recovery.
outcomes: Threat-model financial workflows and trust boundaries
Protect transaction intent, idempotency, ledger integrity, sensitive data, and privileged operations
Design fraud detection, reconciliation, incident response, and regulatory evidence

topics.title: OWASP and NIST Mappings
topics.summary: Use OWASP and NIST frameworks as complementary taxonomies for product risks, security outcomes, controls, evidence, and improvement.
outcomes: Distinguish risk lists, maturity models, control catalogs, and outcome frameworks
Map application findings to organizational security outcomes without claiming equivalence
Build evidence-backed profiles and improvement plans

topics.title: Money Representation
topics.summary: Represent amounts, currencies, precision, rounding, rates, and financial invariants without binary-floating ambiguity.
outcomes: Choose integer-minor-unit or decimal representations
Model currency, scale, rounding, and exchange rates explicitly
Preserve conservation and auditability across calculations

topics.title: Double-Entry Ledgers
topics.summary: Model immutable balanced postings, account invariants, reversals, reconciliation, and audit trails.
outcomes: Preserve balanced postings
Separate business events from ledger entries
Design safe corrections and reconciliation

topics.title: Idempotency
topics.summary: Make retried financial commands produce one intended business effect under timeout, duplication, races, and recovery.
outcomes: Define idempotency scope, key, fingerprint, and retention
Commit result and effect atomically
Handle in-flight, conflicting, failed, and downstream retries

topics.title: Payment Lifecycles
topics.summary: Model payment intent, authorization, capture, clearing, settlement, refund, reversal, dispute, and reconciliation as explicit states.
outcomes: Separate business, processor, ledger, and settlement state
Handle asynchronous and out-of-order events
Design refunds, reversals, disputes, unknown outcomes, and reconciliation

topics.title: Card Networks
topics.summary: Understand card participants, messages, authorization, clearing, settlement, tokenization, disputes, and card-present/not-present risk.
outcomes: Trace merchant, acquirer, network, issuer, and processor roles
Separate authorization, capture, clearing, settlement, and chargeback
Design secure handling, tokenization, retries, and reconciliation

topics.title: UPI
topics.summary: Model UPI participants, collect/pay flows, mandates, asynchronous status, disputes, security, and reconciliation in India.
outcomes: Explain UPI roles and push/collect intent
Design safe transaction identity, status, callback, and reconciliation
Recognize mandate, fraud, PIN, device, and operational concerns

topics.title: Open Banking
topics.summary: Design consented financial-data and payment APIs with federation, scopes, lifecycle, revocation, data minimization, and ecosystem risk.
outcomes: Model customer, provider, consent, authorization, and data-holder roles
Design OAuth/OIDC/FAPI-style authorization and consent
Handle revocation, refresh, webhook, data, and third-party risk

topics.title: Lending Systems
topics.summary: Model applications, underwriting, offers, disbursement, schedules, accrual, payment allocation, delinquency, restructuring, and servicing.
outcomes: Design loan origination and servicing state machines
Generate exact schedules and payment-allocation rules
Separate model decisioning, policy, ledger, collections, and regulatory evidence

topics.title: Reconciliation
topics.summary: Prove agreement among internal ledgers, processors, banks, networks, and customer state through deterministic matching and exceptions.
outcomes: Design source ingestion, normalization, matching, and control totals
Classify timing, fee, duplicate, missing, and amount exceptions
Operate safe correction, audit, aging, and proof of completeness

topics.title: Clearing and Settlement
topics.summary: Understand obligation calculation, netting, collateral, liquidity, settlement assets, finality, delivery-versus-payment, and default risk.
outcomes: Separate clearing, settlement, and finality
Compare gross/net settlement and principal/liquidity/credit risk
Design operations for cutoffs, failures, default, and reconciliation

topics.title: Fraud Systems
topics.summary: Combine rules, models, graphs, identity, operations, experimentation, and feedback to prevent financial abuse with controlled customer friction.
outcomes: Design real-time fraud decision architecture
Evaluate cost, latency, calibration, drift, and delayed labels
Operate review, step-up, block, appeal, and adversarial feedback loops

topics.title: KYC and AML
topics.summary: Engineer risk-based customer due diligence, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, case management, reporting, and evidence lifecycle.
outcomes: Separate identity verification, CDD/EDD, sanctions, and AML monitoring
Design explainable matching, cases, audit, and data governance
Label India-first obligations with review date and compare jurisdictional differences

topics.title: PCI Concepts
topics.summary: Understand PCI DSS scope, cardholder-data flows, segmentation, controls, service providers, evidence, and tokenization without treating compliance as security completeness.
outcomes: Map cardholder-data environment and connected systems
Reduce scope through architecture and validated segmentation
Relate PCI control/evidence responsibilities to engineering operations

topics.title: Auditability
topics.summary: Create complete, immutable, attributable, privacy-aware evidence for financial state, decisions, access, change, and correction.
outcomes: Design event and audit schemas with actor, intent, before/after, and lineage
Protect audit integrity, access, retention, and time
Reconstruct financial and administrative decisions reproducibly

topics.title: Financial Resilience
topics.summary: Keep critical financial services correct and available through dependency failure, overload, regional loss, data corruption, and operational disruption.
outcomes: Define impact tolerances for important business services
Design correctness-preserving degradation and recovery
Test provider, liquidity, data, control-plane, and cyber scenarios

topics.title: Market Microstructure
topics.summary: Understand venues, participants, order types, price formation, spreads, liquidity, fragmentation, execution cost, and market abuse.
outcomes: Explain bid-ask spread, liquidity, impact, adverse selection, and price discovery
Compare order types and venue structures
Measure execution cost and reason about market integrity

topics.title: Order Books
topics.summary: Implement and reason about limit-order-book state, matching, sequencing, market data, replay, recovery, and performance.
outcomes: Implement price-time matching and order lifecycle
Choose data structures for add/cancel/match/best-price operations
Handle sequence gaps, snapshots, replay, and deterministic recovery

topics.title: Stochastic Processes
topics.summary: Use discrete/continuous stochastic processes, Markov models, Brownian motion, martingales, and stochastic calculus with explicit assumptions.
outcomes: Characterize processes by state, filtration, transition, stationarity, and dependence
Explain Markov chains, Poisson processes, Brownian motion, and martingales
Interpret basic SDEs and Itô's lemma for pricing models

topics.title: Time Series
topics.summary: Model temporal dependence, trend, seasonality, stationarity, volatility, leakage, uncertainty, and regime change.
outcomes: Diagnose temporal structure and stationarity
Fit/evaluate ARIMA, state-space, and volatility models
Design walk-forward validation without leakage

topics.title: Derivatives Pricing
topics.summary: Price forwards, futures, options, and swaps using no-arbitrage, replication, risk-neutral expectation, Greeks, trees, PDEs, and simulation.
outcomes: Derive simple forward and option relationships
Explain Black-Scholes assumptions, Greeks, trees, and Monte Carlo
Separate price, model calibration, hedge, and model risk

topics.title: Portfolio and Risk
topics.summary: Connect diversification, covariance, factor exposure, optimization, VaR/expected shortfall, stress, liquidity, and model governance.
outcomes: Derive portfolio mean/variance and diversification
Explain constrained optimization and estimation risk
Use VaR, expected shortfall, stress, factor, liquidity, and concentration measures

topics.title: Backtesting
topics.summary: Evaluate strategies with point-in-time data, realistic execution, costs, controls for bias, robust statistics, and reproducible research.
outcomes: Eliminate look-ahead, survivorship, universe, and timestamp leakage
Simulate orders, fills, costs, capacity, funding, and corporate actions
Control overfitting/multiple testing and run reproducible walk-forward evaluation

topics.title: Low-Latency C++
topics.summary: Engineer predictable C++ latency through measurement, ownership, layout, allocation, concurrency, networking, and failure-aware trade-offs.
outcomes: Measure latency distributions and jitter correctly
Optimize memory layout, allocation, synchronization, and I/O
Reason about affinity, NUMA, kernel bypass, and correctness trade-offs

topics.title: Quant Puzzles
topics.summary: Solve probability, expectation, conditioning, combinatorics, estimation, invariants, and logic puzzles with clear assumptions and checks.
outcomes: Structure puzzles using states, conditioning, symmetry, and indicators
Communicate assumptions and derive rather than guess
Validate answers with bounds, special cases, and simulation sketches

topics.title: India, US, and EU Regulation
topics.summary: Navigate India-first financial technology regulation with US/EU comparisons, entity/product scope, effective dates, and evidence ownership.
outcomes: Identify regulator, legal entity, activity, customer, data, and jurisdiction before applying rules
Compare India, US, and EU regulatory domains without false equivalence
Engineer versioned obligation, control, evidence, and change-management mappings
